Title: CloudAssert multicloud management solution for Hub now available

Body.Content:
CloudAssert, a Microsoft partner that delivers enterprise cloud-based solutions for on-premises, hybrid and public clouds, is announcing a multicloud management solution, which will streamline the management and operations of multiple Azure Stack Hub deployments with a single pane of glass.

Learn more
